page.overview:
Who is Count Jäger?

Count Jäger is a famous priest of Ranald, the god of fortune and thieves, who wanders the city of Altdorf. Those who meet him inevitably receive good fortune, and some believe that he is an avatar of Ranald himself.

Theatrical, ostentatiously ragged, and apparently insane, the old count appears uninvited at parties across the Imperial capital, from the lowliest of slums to the highest of high society. The count brings good fortune to all that see him. The best luck comes to those who interact with him by, say, shaking his hand, saying a word of greeting, or playing a game of cards. His luck is well known, and all who meet him treat him with good will.

Ranaldians are especially pleased to encounter him. Those who expressly seek him out, however, never seem to find him, and those who meet him with cynical intentions receive bad luck instead of good. The count, for his part, seems not to care about all the fuss, but goes about in search of wine, women, and good cheer.

He calls himself "Count Jäger," and so do others, but it's doubtful whether he has any noble heritage. Some, including the Grey Order scholar Lief of Stromdorf believe that Jäger is actually an avatar of Ranald. Others say that he turns into a cat when everybody's back is turned. When asked about these rumours, the count confirms nothing, but winkingly implies that all the stories told about him are true, even the ones that contradict each other.
